items.title: 67425_Tiny Grimes oral history interview
items.q: I don't even remember Oscar Moore sittin' in. And he was one of the greatest guitar players around at that particular time. But he was with the King Cole trio.

ctx.x: --- Oscar Moore, excellent guitar player --- Floyd Smith was an excellent guitar player. He was with Andy Kirk a long time. I got in trouble trying to play his blues. learn how to play his blues ---
When did you first meet Floyd Smith?
